answer.submission_route: Medicaid is run by your state. Appeal through your state Medicaid agency or your managed-care plan, and you can also ask for a state fair hearing. All of the details are on your denial letter. By phone: the number on the back of your insurance card Deadline: Often just 30 to 90 days — act quickly and check your letter -- but your denial letter is authoritative. Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Most state Medicaid programs publish the rules for HOW a decision must be made but not the medical criteria for a specific surgery - those usually sit with your managed-care plan or its review vendor. Ask your plan in writing for 'the clinical criteria applied to my prior authorization', and copy your state Medicaid agency. Massachusetts, North Carolina and California are the exceptions - they publish real procedure criteria.
